articles.title: Scientists tracked 142 Burmese pythons for 20 years; only four expelled transmitters
articles.description: Scientists tracked 142 adult Burmese pythons in southern Florida over 20 years using implanted radio transmitters. Out of 305 transmitters, only four were expelled, all from pregnant females, indicating a low expulsion rate. The study found no transmitter-related deaths and monitored pythons regularly for health issues. Researchers suggest that modifying implantation methods may reduce expulsion risk in pregnant females.

articles.title: Trump’s Male Physique Talk Returns: RFK Jr’s ‘30-year-old’ Body In Focus
articles.description: Donald Trump has sparked another online frenzy after making an unexpected detour from politics to rave about Robert F. Kennedy Jr.’s physique. Speaking at a rally in Fort Myers, Florida, on October 23, the president asked, “Did anybody ever see the build, the body on Bobby?” before declaring the health secretary had the “body of a 30-year-old.” Trump also hailed Kennedy as “the most important Kennedy in the Kennedy family by far.” But the glowing tribute quickly became comedy fodder online, where users mocked the president’s latest body talk, with one critic making a savage comparison to a 30-year-old heroin addict. The remarks have added fresh fuel to the buzz surrounding Trump’s increasingly colourful comments about male politicians’ looks.

articles.title: ‘Largest ever’: Elon Musk donates $443 million to Trump's campaign ahead of US midterms
articles.description: Billionaire Elon Musk has contributed more than $442 million to Republican campaigns as the midterm elections approach. Recent filings show Musk made sizable donations through his America PAC and his company. The PAC has focused spending on competitive Senate races, particularly opposing Democratic candidates in key states. Significant amounts of the funding have directed towards the Texas Senate race and others like Ohio and Michigan.
